title: FOOD SAFETY, CYBERCRIME & ANTI-NARCOTICS DRIVE
paragraphs: State enforcement, health, and police wings have intensified coordinated drives across Hyderabad and Telangana targeting food adulteration and hygiene violations, online financial and digital fraud, and illegal narcotics networks.

Inspections at eateries, warehouses, and retail outlets aim to curb expired or unsafe food items, while cybercrime and anti-narcotics units continue outreach and enforcement against fraudulent investment links, impersonation calls, and substance trafficking around campuses and residential neighbourhoods.
Timely citizen reporting and basic daily precautions play a vital role in preventing health hazards, financial loss, and community harm.

IMPORTANT: In cyber fraud cases, reporting within the first hour (the “golden hour”) significantly improves the chances of freezing suspicious bank transfers. Never share OTPs, bank credentials, or remote-access permissions with unknown callers.
checklistTitle: A RESPONSIBLE REQUEST TO EVERY CITIZEN
checklist: Verify Food Quality & Labels: Check FSSAI registration, manufacturing/expiry dates, and intact packaging before buying groceries or dining out.
Guard Against Cyber Scams: Ignore unknown APK links, fake courier/police video calls, and guaranteed return investment messages.
Stay Alert Against Narcotics: Report suspicious substance activity near schools, colleges, hostels, or commercial hubs immediately.
Report Violations Promptly: Use official helplines to flag unhygienic food outlets, online fraud attempts, or suspicious parcels.
Avoid Unverified Forwards: Do not circulate unconfirmed rumours or names; share verified helpline numbers instead.
contacts: OFFICIAL HELPLINE & REPORTING CONTACTS Cybercrime Helpline: 1930 (cybercrime.gov.in)  |  Anti-Narcotics Helpline: 1908  |  Emergency & Police: 112  |  Food Safety Complaints: 1800-112-100 (FSSAI)
closingNote: T&C NEWS:   We do not encourage panic. We encourage awareness. Enforcement agencies conduct regular inspections and crackdowns to safeguard public health and law and order. As citizens, staying informed, verifying before trusting, and reporting through official channels keeps our neighbourhoods safe.
disclaimer: This is an independent public-awareness publication by T&C News. It is not an official police, FSSAI, or government notification. Citizens are advised to verify updates and register complaints through official portals and helplines.

title: AI TRAFFIC SIGNAL SYSTEM (429 JUNCTIONS)
paragraphs: Civic and traffic authorities are advancing plans to deploy an AI-driven adaptive traffic signal system across 429 major junctions in Hyderabad under the Core Urban Region Economy (CURE) initiative to ease peak-hour congestion and improve junction flow.

Unlike fixed-timer signals, adaptive AI signals use real-time traffic cameras and sensors to measure vehicle queues on each arm of a junction and dynamically adjust green-light durations—reducing unnecessary waiting on empty stretches and creating green corridors for emergency vehicles.

As installation, calibration, and corridor integration roll out in phases, commuters may notice temporary lane markings, camera poles, and signal timing adjustments at key intersections across the city.

IMPORTANT:   Adaptive AI signals adjust green durations based on live traffic density rather than a fixed countdown. Commuters should watch signal lights and stop lines carefully instead of anticipating old timer patterns or jumping red lights.
checklistTitle: A RESPONSIBLE REQUEST TO EVERY COMMUTER
checklist: Respect Stop Lines & Signals: Stop behind the painted stop line so overhead sensors and cameras can accurately detect waiting traffic queues.
Avoid Signal Jumping: Do not accelerate early or cross on amber/red; automated junction cameras actively record red-light and stop-line violations.
Maintain Lane Discipline: Stay within marked lanes at busy intersections to allow smooth turning movements and faster clearance cycles.
Give Way to Emergency Vehicles: Move aside safely when ambulances or fire tenders approach so emergency green-corridor clearance works smoothly.
Plan Around Roadworks: Expect minor calibration delays at junctions undergoing upgrades and follow official traffic police diversion updates.
contacts: OFFICIAL TRAFFIC & EMERGENCY CONTACTS For traffic updates, signal malfunctions, or road emergencies, dial 112 or contact the Hyderabad / Cyberabad Traffic Police helpline.
closingNote: T&C NEWS:   We do not encourage panic. We encourage awareness. Modern traffic technology works best when paired with disciplined road behaviour. As citizens and daily commuters, following lane rules and signal lights helps reduce travel time and prevents junction accidents for everyone.
disclaimer: This is an independent public-awareness publication by T&C News. It is not an official police, GHMC, or government notification. Commuters are advised to follow official traffic advisories issued by local authorities.

title: SIR VERIFY YOUR VOTE WITH CLARITY, NOT CONFUSION
paragraphs: The ongoing Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls has raised widespread questions among households, newly married citizens, senior citizens, and out-of-station workers regarding enumeration forms, record matching, and voter eligibility

During house-to-house verification, Booth Level Officers (BLOs) distribute and collect enumeration forms to update electoral records accurately. Rumours circulating on messaging groups have falsely claimed that missing earlier roll mapping or not submitting Aadhaar leads to automatic deletion of names.

Under Election Commission procedures, eligible voters are given formal opportunities to verify records, respond to discrepancies, and file claims or corrections before the final electoral roll is published.

IMPORTANT:  Receiving a verification notice or finding an unmatched record does not mean your vote is automatically cancelled. No eligible voter's name is removed without due verification and prior notice under election rules.
checklist: Check Your Roll Status: Search your name and EPIC details online on the official Election Commission portal (voters.eci.gov.in) or the ECINET mobile app.
Aadhaar Is Voluntary: Providing Aadhaar during enumeration is optional; lack of Aadhaar does not disqualify an eligible citizen from being on the voter list.
Keep Your Signed Acknowledgement: When submitting the two-copy enumeration form to your BLO, always retain your signed receipt copy for future reference.
Use Official Forms for Updates: Submit Form 6 for new enrolment, Form 8 for address shift or name/photo corrections, and respond promptly if a BLO notice is issued
Ignore Unverified Rumours: Rely only on official Election Commission notices, your assigned BLO, or verified helpline channels before forwarding messages.
contacts: OFFICIAL VOTER HELPLINE & VERIFICATION CHANNELS: Dial 1950 (Voter Helpline) or visit voters.eci.gov.in to check roll status, locate your Booth Level Officer (BLO), or track submitted forms
closingNote: T&C NEWS:  We do not encourage panic. We encourage awareness. Electoral roll revision is a routine administrative exercise to keep voter lists accurate and inclusive. As citizens, our responsibility is to verify our details calmly, cooperate with Booth Level Officers, and avoid spreading misinformation.
disclaimer: This is an independent public-awareness publication by T&C News. It is not an official Election Commission of India or government notification. Citizens are advised to verify dates and forms on official ECI portals.

title: SECURITY IS A SHARED RESPONSIBILITY
paragraphs: A security alert dated 21 November 2026, reportedly issued by the Hyderabad Police Special Branch, has instructed police personnel to strengthen security arrangements and surveillance following a threatening email claiming links to Lashkar-e-Taiba (LeT).

The circulated alert identifies Hotel Tourist Plaza, Kachiguda, and Kachiguda Railway Station as the locations mentioned in the threat. It also calls for increased vigilance at crowded public places, hotels, railway stations, bus stations, religious places and other important installations.

According to subsequent media reports, police conducted anti-sabotage checks and intensified security measures. The Telangana DGP reportedly indicated that the email was most likely fake, while authorities continued following precautionary procedures.
IMPORTANT: A threat claiming affiliation with a terrorist organisation does not establish that the organisation was actually responsible. The matter is under investigation.
checklistTitle: A RESPONSIBLE REQUEST TO EVERY CITIZEN
checklist: Stay Alert: Remain aware of unusual activities around you.
Stay Calm: Do not create or spread unnecessary panic.
Do Not Touch: Never approach or handle unattended suspicious objects.
Report Immediately: Inform the nearest police station about suspicious activity.
Avoid Rumours: Verify information before sharing it with others.
closingNote: T&C NEWS: We do not encourage panic. We encourage awareness. Police departments and security agencies have their own established procedures to assess threats and take precautionary action. As citizens, our responsibility is to remain vigilant, cooperate with authorities and report anything genuinely suspicious.
disclaimer: This is an independent public-awareness publication by T&C News. It is not an official police or government notification. The circulating Special Branch document has not been independently authenticated by T&C News.

title: CIVIC ADVISORY | SAVE WATER
paragraphs: The bulletin (dated November 25, 2026) highlights an upcoming water scarcity Zero Day alert in Hyderabad starting December 15, urging residents to stay calm, conserve water, fix leaks, store supplies responsibly, and rely on verified updates rather than rumors.
It notes that this is an independent public-awareness bulletin by T&C News rather than an official government or HMWSSB notification.

IMPORTANT: An advisory projecting a critical threshold on 15 December 2026 is an early-warning conservation alert, not a confirmation of total supply shutdown. Timely citizen cooperation and demand reduction can significantly delay and mitigate acute shortages.
checklistTitle: A RESPONSIBLE REQUEST TO EVERY CITIZEN
checklist: Stay Calm: Do not engage in panic hoarding or excessive water storage that drains local distribution pressure.
Fix Leaks Promptly: Repair dripping taps, overflowing overhead tanks, and faulty plumbing fixtures without delay.
Report Wastage & Leaks: Inform civic water authorities immediately about pipeline bursts, illegal tapping, or major public leaks.
Avoid Rumours: Verify water supply schedules and official announcements before forwarding unverified messages.
closingNote: T&C NEWS: We do not encourage panic. We encourage awareness. Municipal water boards and civic agencies have established contingency plans to manage reservoir reserves and regulate equitable distribution. As citizens, our responsibility is to use water judiciously, cooperate with authorities.
disclaimer: This is an independent public-awareness publication by T&C News. It is not an official government or municipal water board bulletin. Citizens are advised to follow verified updates issued by local civic authorities.
